title: WCAG principles and practical checks
description: Apply Perceivable, Operable, Understandable and Robust principles to a local page and document bounded accessibility findings without claiming WCAG certification.
objectives: Explain the four POUR principles with practical examples
Link accessibility observations to testable behavior rather than style preferences
Produce a bounded self-assessment instead of a conformance claim
Use native grouped controls and clear feedback
rubric: I explained each POUR principle with one concrete testable observation.
I produced an honest preliminary self-assessment without compliance claims.
I reviewed the normative criteria needed for a fuller audit.
